# TPC-DS-OBT Q85

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT SUBSTRING(reason_r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(quantity), AVG(refunded_cash), AVG(return_fee) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (web_page_sk = web_page_wp_web_page_sk AND item_sk = item_sk AND sale_id = sale_id AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND returning_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = returning_cdemo_cd_demo_sk AND returning_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = returning_cdemo_cd_demo_sk AND returning_addr_ca_address_sk = returning_addr_ca_address_sk AND reason_r_reason_sk = reason_sk AND ((returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = returning_cdemo_cd_education_status AND sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00) OR (returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = returning_cdemo_cd_education_status AND sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00) OR (returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status = returning_cdemo_cd_marital_status AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1' AND returning_cdemo_cd_education_status = returning_cdemo_cd_education_status AND sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)) AND ((returning_addr_ca_country = 'United States' AND returning_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3') AND net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) OR (returning_addr_ca_country = 'United States' AND returning_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3') AND net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300) OR (returning_addr_ca_country = 'United States' AND returning_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3') AND net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250))) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY reason_r_reason_desc ORDER BY SUBSTRING(reason_r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(quantity), AVG(refunded_cash), AVG(return_fee) LIMIT 100
```
